notes:
Summary: Oxley Vertex is a product analytics SaaS (mid-market) building an in-app assistant + improved search. Started on Hosted API; moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Wants a short Dedicated POC to validate canary routing, model variants, and region failover. Key ask: deterministic performance under peak (120 QPS burst), easy rollback and clear cost profile.

Meeting highlights (shorthand):
- 01/15 hosted demo: 'fast to integrate, results promising' — engineering liked SDKs.
- 02/12 kickoff: agreed POC scope: 2-week bench + 2-week canary in prod slice.
- 02/25 arch call: canonical canary plan: 5% traffic -> dedicated canary pool (lower-cost variant) -> monitor latency, token cost, correctness metrics. Fallback: if error rate >1% or p95 latency >350ms -> route to hosted fallback or alternate model variant in same region. Region failover: primary NA, secondary EU (data residency to be considered for EU customers).
- Finance: needs clear per-token and per-minute GPU cost buckets for commit sizing.
- Security: SOC2 report requested; legal wants DPA + data residency clause for EU customers.

Stated constraints: VPC-only deployment for Dedicated, KMS integration mandatory, retention controls to meet 12 month retention policy for certain datasets. CTO quote: 'We need predictable tail latency and a safe rollback path — can't have noisy model swaps.'

Current sentiment: warm, pragmatic. AE and SE have high credibility. Next immediate deliverable: detailed POC runbook + cost worksheet from Redwood (Jordan to provide by 2026-03-05).
summary: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated. POC centered on Dedicated with canary routing, model variants, regional failover, rollback policy, and cost transparency.
poc_plan: POC scope: Dedicated reserved pool (2 GPU nodes), instrumented canary (5% traffic) for 2 weeks, followed by 2-week progressive ramp. Routing: policy-based smart router handles canary to canary-pool; fallback rules: model-variant downgrade + cross-region failover to hosted pool. Success metrics: p50 latency <150ms, p95 <350ms, availability >=99.9%, relevance delta <2% on core reranking evals. Deliverables: benchmark report, cost model, runbook for failover and rollback.
tech_requirements: Throughput target: sustained 60 QPS, 120 QPS burst. Token patterns: average 60 tokens/request. Preferred models: open-weight Llama-2 style variants and 3B/7B quantized variants for cost testing. KV-cache reuse important for sessioned chat. Must support streaming and function/tool-calling for assistant features.
sales_notes: AE notes: price sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to 12-month reserved if cost per effective token meets target. Suggested commercial: start with 3-month pilot commit, then scale. Ask finance for 12-month ARR model. Keep CSM looped early.
internal_next_steps: 1) SE to ship POC topology diagram + infra checklist (due 2026-03-05). 2) Solutions to produce cost worksheet for committed vs burst pricing. 3) Legal to provide DPA template and SOC2 evidence. 4) Schedule canary deploy with DevOps (target week of 2026-03-22).
